result.reason: The operative language does not reach the fallback. Although it creates a mutual 12-month-fee cap, only Licensor’s indemnification obligations are uncapped, rather than indemnification obligations generally. More importantly, the retained liability stack broadly immunizes Licensor and limits recovery to direct damages for Licensor’s gross negligence or willful misconduct, undermining the new mutual cap and the confidentiality, security, fraud, and indemnity carve-outs. The unilateral Article XIII exclusion and express IP-infringement immunity also remain, notwithstanding the margin comment. The changes are confined to the liability allocation and therefore are minimal and preserve unrelated intent, but the conflicting and duplicative provisions make the drafting internally inconsistent.
